Puig not only designed these frame sliders to protect the motorcycle, but the rider too. All Puig R12 Frame Sliders feature a rubber bumper cap to avoid knee and shin injuries from impact in the event of a crash.

Features:

Protects engine and frame
All sliders include grey rubber bumper
Includes all necessary installation hardware
Slider impact area measures 71mm W x 58mm H
Sold in pairs
Requires no bodywork modification

source_description_html:
Puig R12 Frame Sliders Kawasaki Ninja 1000

The Puig R12 Frame Sliders were designed to fit in between the width of a motorcycles stock handlebars and foot pegs. In the event of a crash, this design allows the stock footpegs to fold up and the handlebars and controls to stay off the ground. This sweet spot allows the nylon slider to take the majority of the damage. These mid-length frame sliders also have less of a tendency to catch on uneven surfaces, unlike long frame sliders that can cause the motorcycle to flip through the air.

Puig not only designed these frame sliders to protect the motorcycle, but the rider too. All Puig R12 Frame Sliders feature a rubber bumper cap to avoid knee and shin injuries from impact in the event of a crash.

Features:

Protects engine and frame
All sliders include grey rubber bumper
Includes all necessary installation hardware
Slider impact area measures 71mm W x 58mm H
Sold in pairs
Requires no bodywork modification

source_description_html:
Give your bike the competitive character you've always looked for with the Puig Racing screen.
Manufactured in 3mm high impact acrylic, resistant and long-lasting material rounded to> 2mm (complying with German TÜV regulations), thanks to its double height, the effect of air hitting on the helmet will be greatly reduced. This screen is available in two models: Z-Racing and R-Racer, depending on the model.

The design of the Z-Racing screen has been tested in the wind tunnel, improving the aerodynamic coefficient and the protection against wind gusts by 12.7% (upright position) with respect to the original model and by 61% in racing position.

On the other hand, the R-Racer screens, apart from being studied in the wind tunnel, are developed together with racing teams from the SBK World Championship and Endurance, achieving a perfect balance between protection and aerodynamics.
The assembly of the piece does not require modifications and is accompanied by an exhaustive aerodynamic study.

name: Puig Racing Windscreen for Ducati Panigale 899
source_title: Puig Racing Windscreen for Ducati Panigale 899
description: Give your bike the competitive character you've always looked for with the Puig Racing screen. Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
Give your bike the competitive character you've always looked for with the Puig Racing screen.
Manufactured in 3mm high impact acrylic, resistant and long-lasting material rounded to> 2mm (complying with German TÜV regulations), thanks to its double height, the effect of air hitting on the helmet will be greatly reduced. This screen is available in two models: Z-Racing and R-Racer, depending on the model.

The design of the Z-Racing screen has been tested in the wind tunnel, improving the aerodynamic coefficient and the protection against wind gusts by 12.7% (upright position) with respect to the original model and by 61% in racing position.

On the other hand, the R-Racer screens, apart from being studied in the wind tunnel, are developed together with racing teams from the SBK World Championship and Endurance, achieving a perfect balance between protection and aerodynamics.
The assembly of the piece does not require modifications and is accompanied by an exhaustive aerodynamic study.

Replace the original license plate holder of your motorcycle with the Puig license plate holder. Its elevated location gives a Racing character to your motorcycle. The set combines pieces of steel finished in epoxy paint with pieces in Polyamide, achieving an important reduction of weight with respect to the original support.
Some of the supports have the option of being fixed or adjustable according to the reference that adheres to each motorcycle.

Puig serves the piece together with a kit that includes lighting group of the most catadioptric license plate, approved according to model.

The assembly of the piece is very simple and comes with instructions.

The assembly of the piece does not require modifications and is accompanied by an exhaustive aerodynamic study.

The assembly of the piece is very simple and comes with instructions.

name: Puig Racing Windscreen for Suzuki Hayabusa 2010-2017
source_title: Puig Racing Windscreen for Suzuki Hayabusa 2010-2017
description: Give your bike the competitive character you've always looked for with the Puig Racing screen. Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
Give your bike the competitive character you've always looked for with the Puig Racing screen.
Manufactured in 3mm high impact acrylic, resistant and long-lasting material rounded to> 2mm (complying with German TÜV regulations), thanks to its double height, the effect of air hitting on the helmet will be greatly reduced. This screen is available in two models: Z-Racing and R-Racer, depending on the model.

The design of the Z-Racing screen has been tested in the wind tunnel, improving the aerodynamic coefficient and the protection against wind gusts by 12.7% (upright position) with respect to the original model and by 61% in racing position.

On the other hand, the R-Racer screens, apart from being studied in the wind tunnel, are developed together with racing teams from the SBK World Championship and Endurance, achieving a perfect balance between protection and aerodynamics.
The assembly of the piece does not require modifications and is accompanied by an exhaustive aerodynamic study.

description: Provide your motorcycle with the sport character you have always looked for, with the racing screen from Puig. Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
Provide your motorcycle with the sport character you have always looked for, with the racing screen from Puig.

The Z-RACING line is based on balancing an agressive stance in accordance to your motorcycle, while keeping comfort and functionality for the rider.

The Z-Racing screens are designed to be more aerodynamically efficient than their stock ones, they are fully tested in the virtual wind tunnel to garantee improvements in the aerodinamic coeficient (Cx) and the aerodynamic protection to the rider. Thanks to its doble height, they deflect the wind that would otherwise hit the helmet and top area of the torso. In the meantime, the side channels pick up air flow and send it sideways with the objective of reducing air pressure from the rider’s shoulders.

The aerodinamic protection improvement is of 12,7% (on average with the upper body up) versus the original model and of 61% in the “racing” position.

Designed and manufactured in Barcelona, with the most advanced technologies, with high impact acrylic of 3mm. We come up with a very strong piece, light, durable and with a rounded edge of 2mm (accomplishing the safety control from the German TÜV). The artificial vision system utilized during the quality control process guarantee that the screens will get to the client in perfect shape.

The Z-Racing screens are available in a wide range of colors to personalize your motorcycle to your taste.

Instalation of the screen doesn’t require aditional parts like trims and every screen comes with an in depth aerodynamic study that indicates the improvement in performance, as well as the protection to the rider.

The Puig R12 Frame Sliders were designed to fit in between the width of a motorcycles stock handlebars and foot pegs. In the event of a crash, this design allows the stock footpegs to fold up and the handlebars and controls to stay off the ground. This sweet spot allows the nylon slider to take the majority of the damage. These mid-length frame sliders also have less of a tendency to catch on uneven surfaces, unlike long frame sliders that can cause the motorcycle to flip through the air.

Puig not only designed these frame sliders to protect the motorcycle, but the rider too. All Puig R12 Frame Sliders feature a rubber bumper cap to avoid knee and shin injuries from impact in the event of a crash.

Features:

  • Protects engine and frame
  • All sliders include grey rubber bumper
  • Includes all necessary installation hardware
  • Slider impact area measures 71mm W x 58mm H
  • Sold in pairs
  • Requires no bodywork modification

This sweet spot allows the nylon slider to take the majority of the damage. The new D12 spoiler line by Puig has been created with a clear goal: to put aerodynamics above all else. These side spoilers have been developed to deliver maximum aerodynamic performance on high-performance motorcycles.

The innovative double-wing design, with separate surfaces divided by a lateral spoiler, channels airflow upwards, generating greater downforce without compromising the overall aerodynamic coefficient. The angle of the surfaces has been carefully studied to offer an optimal balance between performance and stability.

Thanks to this configuration, the system delivers up to 4.4 kg of downforce on the front axle, resulting in an anti-wheelie effect, greater high-speed stability (anti-shimmie), improved braking stability, and better behavior during directional changes.

Specifically designed for the Kawasaki ZX-6R Ninja’23, the Side Downforce Race spoilers have been developed benefiting from Puig's experience in top-level competition, such as MotoGP and WorldSBK championships, taking into account the latest aerodynamic innovations. source_description_html:
Provide your motorcycle with the sport character you have always looked for, with the racing screen from Puig.

The Z-RACING line is based on balancing an agressive stance in accordance to your motorcycle, while keeping comfort and functionality for the rider.

The Z-Racing screens are designed to be more aerodynamically efficient than their stock ones, they are fully tested in the virtual wind tunnel to garantee improvements in the aerodinamic coeficient (Cx) and the aerodynamic protection to the rider. Thanks to its doble height, they deflect the wind that would otherwise hit the helmet and top area of the torso. In the meantime, the side channels pick up air flow and send it sideways with the objective of reducing air pressure from the rider’s shoulders.  

The aerodinamic protection improvement is of 12,7% (on average with the upper body up) versus the original model and of 61% in the “racing” position.

Designed and manufactured in Barcelona, with the most advanced technologies, with high impact acrylic of 3mm. We come up with a very strong piece, light, durable and with a rounded edge of 2mm (accomplishing the safety control from the German TÜV). The artificial vision system utilized during the quality control process guarantee that the screens will get to the client in perfect shape.

The Z-Racing screens are available in a wide range of colors to personalize your motorcycle to your taste.

Instalation of the screen doesn’t require aditional parts like trims and every screen comes with an in depth aerodynamic study that indicates the improvement in performance, as well as the protection to the rider.

DIMENSIONS (LENGTH X WIDTH): 380 X 305 MM

70 mm. higher than the original
Thickness: 3 mm

The Puig R19 Frame Sliders were designed to fit in between the width of a motorcycles stock handlebars and foot pegs. In the event of a crash, this design allows the stock footpegs to fold up and the handlebars and controls to stay off the ground. This sweet spot allows the nylon slider to take the majority of the damage. These mid-length frame sliders also have less of a tendency to catch on uneven surfaces, unlike long frame sliders that can cause the motorcycle to flip through the air.

Puig not only designed these frame sliders to protect the motorcycle, but the rider too. All Puig R19 Frame Sliders feature a rubber bumper cap to avoid knee and shin injuries from impact in the event of a crash.

description: Pre Order Import on Order only
source_description_html:

Pre Order Import on Order only

Now you can benefit from the racing aerodynamic technology in your motorcycle. Puig Downforce winglets have been developed thanks to the experience and tests carried out by the Kawasaki Racing team in the WorldSBK championship. Get the ultimate racing touch and improve the cornering of your motorcycle with these downforce winglets.

The fitting of these spoilers improves stability at high speeds and reduces the risk of shimmie effect, which occurs when losing traction on the front wheel and can lead to complete loss of control. In addition, the side winglets help changes of direction at high speeds by channeling the air through the piece. A downforce that also promises the antiwheelie effect in strong accelerations by generating downward downforce of up to 6 kilograms on the front axle. The exact results of the virtual wind tunnel test can be viewed for each model.

Puig Downforce Winglets have been designed and manufactured in Barcelona, following the latest developments in MotoGP and WorldSBK aerodynamics. Thanks to the advances and avant-garde technologies of the firm, you will be able to equip your street motorcycle with the best innovations and features of the high competition, in addition to providing an aggressive aesthetic and personalizing your motorcycle thanks to the wide range of available colors.

Manufacturing has taken the safety regulations into account, with rounded edges and a radius of >2 mm. The assembly is simple, does not require drilling the fairing, and is assembled quickly following the detailed instructions supplied with the winglets.

In the event of a crash, this design allows the stock footpegs to fold up and the handlebars and controls to stay off the ground. This sweet spot allows the nylon slider to take the majority of the damage. These mid-length frame sliders also have less of a tendency to catch on uneven surfaces, unlike long frame sliders that can cause the motorcycle to flip through the air.

Puig not only designed these frame sliders to protect the motorcycle, but the rider too. All Puig R19 Frame Sliders feature a rubber bumper cap to avoid knee and shin injuries from impact in the event of a crash.

  • All sliders include grey rubber bumper

name: Puig Tail Tidy for Kawasaki Ninja 650
source_title: Puig Tail Tidy for Kawasaki Ninja 650
description: Replace the original license plate holder of your motorcycle with the Puig license plate holder. Its elevated location gives a Racing character to your motorcycle.…
source_description_html:
Replace the original license plate holder of your motorcycle with the Puig license plate holder. Its elevated location gives a Racing character to your motorcycle. The set combines pieces of steel finished in epoxy paint with pieces in Polyamide, achieving an important reduction of weight with respect to the original support.
Some of the supports have the option of being fixed or adjustable according to the reference that adheres to each motorcycle.
The support comes with space for the indicators, remember that it is not suitable for the originals, and is adjustable up to 3 cm. Note that the support is not served with intermittent, they must be purchased separately. Another point to keep in mind is that connectors are not used to connect the license plate light.
Puig serves the piece together with a kit that includes lighting group of the most catadioptric license plate, approved according to model.

The assembly of the piece is very simple and comes with instructions.

name: Puig Z-Racing Windscreen for Aprilia RS 457
source_title: Puig Z-Racing Windscreen for Aprilia RS 457
description: Provide your motorcycle with the sport character you have always looked for, with the racing screen from Puig. Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
Provide your motorcycle with the sport character you have always looked for, with the racing screen from Puig.

The Z-RACING line is based on balancing an agressive stance in accordance to your motorcycle, while keeping comfort and functionality for the rider.

The Z-Racing screens are designed to be more aerodynamically efficient than their stock ones, they are fully tested in the virtual wind tunnel to garantee improvements in the aerodinamic coeficient (Cx) and the aerodynamic protection to the rider. Thanks to its doble height, they deflect the wind that would otherwise hit the helmet and top area of the torso. In the meantime, the side channels pick up air flow and send it sideways with the objective of reducing air pressure from the rider’s shoulders.  

The aerodinamic protection improvement is of 12,7% (on average with the upper body up) versus the original model and of 61% in the “racing” position.

Designed and manufactured in Barcelona, with the most advanced technologies, with high impact acrylic of 3mm. We come up with a very strong piece, light, durable and with a rounded edge of 2mm (accomplishing the safety control from the German TÜV). The artificial vision system utilized during the quality control process guarantee that the screens will get to the client in perfect shape.

DIMENSIONS (HEIGHT X WIDTH): 380 x 265 MM

30 mm. higher than the original.

description: Provide your motorcycle with the sport character you have always looked for, with the racing screen from Puig. Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
Provide your motorcycle with the sport character you have always looked for, with the racing screen from Puig.

The Z-RACING line is based on balancing an agressive stance in accordance to your motorcycle, while keeping comfort and functionality for the rider.

The Z-Racing screens are designed to be more aerodynamically efficient than their stock ones, they are fully tested in the virtual wind tunnel to garantee improvements in the aerodinamic coeficient (Cx) and the aerodynamic protection to the rider. Thanks to its doble height, they deflect the wind that would otherwise hit the helmet and top area of the torso. In the meantime, the side channels pick up air flow and send it sideways with the objective of reducing air pressure from the rider’s shoulders.  

The aerodinamic protection improvement is of 12,7% (on average with the upper body up) versus the original model and of 61% in the “racing” position.

Designed and manufactured in Barcelona, with the most advanced technologies, with high impact acrylic of 3mm. We come up with a very strong piece, light, durable and with a rounded edge of 2mm (accomplishing the safety control from the German TÜV). The artificial vision system utilized during the quality control process guarantee that the screens will get to the client in perfect shape.

The Z-Racing screens are available in a wide range of colors to personalize your motorcycle to your taste.

Instalation of the screen doesn’t require aditional parts like trims and every screen comes with an in depth aerodynamic study that indicates the improvement in performance, as well as the protection to the rider.

DIMENSIONS (LENGTH X WIDTH): 460 X 450 MM

60 mm. higher than the original
Thickness: 3 mm

description: The New Generation Adjustable is a screen for your bike that comes equipped with a mechanism that attaches it to the bike and allows you… Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
The New Generation Adjustable is a screen for your bike that comes equipped with a mechanism that attaches it to the bike and allows you to adjust its position for the aerodynamic protection of the rider at any moment while on a ride. This adjustment can be done manually, usually by means of an adjustable knob and without the need for tools.
 
The New Generation Adjustable is specially designed to adapt as much as possible to the bike. It mounts with metal supports, light and resistant, with an anti-corrosion treatment to protect them from friction and inclement weather.

The mounting screens have also been specifically designed and in some cases several screen models are offered for further customization.

Assembly is simple as the New Generation Adjustable is delivered as a set that is easily installed on the bike thanks to detailed step-by-step instructions that are available via the web in PDF, video and paper.

Puig's adjustable NG Touring windshield provides extra protection while maintaining the attractive and peculiar design of the Italian Muscle Bike. With two main edges and a lateral cut according to the shapes of the Diavel V4 tank, creating a perfect symbiosis between the motorcycle and the screen.

Thanks to its manual regulation mechanism we can change the inclination of the screen according to the need for protection. In addition to being able to place the screen in two positions, it can also be fixed in an ideal intermediate position for each rider.

With its installation, it increases aerodynamic protection, by effectively diverting the air that would impact the rider’s torso, significantly improving riding comfort and reducing fatigue.

name: Puig Oil-Carter Guard for BMW R 1300 GS
source_title: Puig Oil-Carter Guard for BMW R 1300 GS
description: Protects the underbody of the engine and the headers of the German trails. Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
Protects the underbody of the engine and the headers of the German trails.

With its installation, valuable and sensitive areas are protected from receiving damage and impacts from stones and mud, such as the crankcase and the union of the headers, even more important if we take into account the Offroad possibilities offered by both models.

It adapts perfectly to the lower part of the motorcycle, integrating into the whole while giving it a more adventurous and personalized image. Its installation does not affect the aerodynamics of the motorcycle.

The lower part of the protector is completely flat, which makes it easier to lift the motorcycle from the lower part in the mechanical workshop if necessary, and it has holes to guarantee good cooling and to evacuate water, mud, or small accumulated stones. In addition to facilitating the oil change operation avoiding removing the protector.

Designed and manufactured in Barcelona, it is made of high-end 4mm-thick aluminum, resulting in a very resistant piece as well as light, and has a matt silver anodized finish. It includes specific metal supports with anti-corrosion treatment painted in textured black for a discreet and elegant finish.

The protector is fixed to the lower part of the motorcycle with anti-vibration rubber supports that absorb any possible blows that the protector may receive, distributing the impact force through the different fixing points and, in turn, eliminating possible annoying noises that exist when these rubbers are not being used.

It is assembled quickly and easily without the need of mechanical knowledge, you just have to follow the step-by-step instructions that are supplied on paper and can be checked online.

Provide your motorcycle with the sport character you have always looked for, with the racing screen from Puig.

The Z-RACING line is based on balancing an agressive stance in accordance to your motorcycle, while keeping comfort and functionality for the rider.

Thanks to its doble height, they deflect the wind that would otherwise hit the helmet and top area of the torso. The artificial vision system utilized during the quality control process guarantee that the screens will get to the client in perfect shape.

The Z-Racing screens are available in a wide range of colors to personalize your motorcycle to your taste.

Instalation of the screen doesn’t require aditional parts like trims and every screen comes with an in depth aerodynamic study that indicates the improvement in performance, as well as the protection to the rider.
